versions.content: Communication Use case of the V2X Data Manager where isService = true In this communication scenario, the V2X Data Manager sends the data to a SwComponentPrototype on the same EcuInstance . In this case it is foreseen to use a standardized SenderReceiverInterface that set the at- tribute isService to true and define a SwcServiceDependency that aggregates a V2xDataManagerNeeds . In this case, the connection between PPortPrototype owned by the SwCompo- nentType representing the V2X DM's service component and the AbstractRe- quiredPortPrototype owned by the SwComponentType typed by an Applica- tionSwComponentType is established by an AssemblySwConnector .
